name: Gamee

descriptions.text: Unauthorized GitLab access exposed GAMEE’s Polygon deployer key on 2024-01-22, allowing 600 million GMEE to leave team-controlled reserves and be sold through decentralized exchanges. Public USD loss estimates conflict, so the incident is treated as evidence-limited. Unauthorized access to a historical GitLab repository exposed the Polygon deployer private key, giving the attacker privileged authority over GMEE token movements and contract administration. The public evidence in this record does not establish a contract arithmetic bug as the trigger.

GAMEE reported unauthorized GitLab access that exposed the Polygon GMEE deployer key on 2024-01-22. Public reporting says about 600 million GMEE left team reserves and were swapped through DEXs, with losses estimated at roughly $15 million to $16.4 million. A GitLab-exposed deployer private key gave the attacker control of the privileged Polygon GMEE contract authority. The available record does not establish a separate Solidity code defect.

An attacker was able to gain access to the Gamee (GMEE) token's source code repository, then exploit a vulnerability in the code to transfer 600 million GMEE tokens to their own wallets. At the token's market price of $0.025 before the hack, these tokens were ostensibly priced at $15 million, though the token value plunged around 60% to below $0.01 following the theft as the attacker began selling the tokens. GMEE is the token belonging to the Gamee blockchain-based gaming platform, which was acquired by the Animoca Brands company in 2020. Animoca is mostly known for its crypto-metaverse project, The Sandbox.
